d: Join Hitachi Energy as a Field Service Engineer - GIS and play a key role in supporting critical power infrastructure that helps deliver reliable and sustainable energy. This is an exciting opportunity for an experienced professional to apply deep technical expertise in Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems while working with advanced technologies and a diverse range of customer projects. In this role, the successful candidate will provide expert technical support, lead troubleshooting and maintenance activities, and contribute to the safe and reliable operation of high-voltage equipment. The position offers the chance to solve complex technical challenges, collaborate with skilled engineering teams, support customers in maximizing asset performance, and make a meaningful impact on the energy transition. As part of Hitachi Energy's commitment to innovation, quality, and continuous improvement, this role provides opportunities for professional growth, knowledge sharing, and participation in industry-leading service solutions.
q: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering, or a related field.
Minimum of 7 years of experience working with Gas Insulated Switchgear (GIS) systems.
Strong knowledge of GIS components, operating principles, and common failure modes.
Proven experience in GIS installation, commissioning, maintenance, and troubleshooting activities.
Familiarity with applicable international and national electrical safety standards and regulations.
Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, single-line diagrams, and technical drawings.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex electrical issues.
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams and customers.
Ability to work independently, prioritize responsibilities, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
Valid driver's license and willingness to travel to project sites as required.
Experience with Hitachi Energy GIS products and systems is considered a strong advantage

r: Perform installation, commissioning, maintenance, and repair activities for GIS equipment, including circuit breakers, disconnectors, and earthing switches.
Conduct routine inspections, diagnostic testing, and preventive maintenance on GIS systems to identify and address potential issues.
Troubleshoot complex GIS malfunctions, determine root causes, and implement effective corrective actions.
Develop and execute maintenance procedures and schedules in accordance with manufacturer specifications and industry best practices.
Share technical knowledge and provide guidance to technicians and engineers on GIS operation and maintenance.
Collaborate with engineering and project teams on GIS design reviews, upgrades, retrofits, and modifications.
Maintain accurate records of maintenance activities, repairs, testing results, and equipment performance data.
Ensure compliance with all applicable health, safety, environmental, quality, and regulatory requirements during GIS operations and maintenance activities.
Prepare technical reports, service documentation, and recommendations related to GIS performance and reliability.
Support emergency response activities and provide timely assistance during critical equipment failures, as required.
You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
Living Hitachi Energy’s core values safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

were always at the forefront pushing boundaries. Were on the lookout for exceptional IT professionals to fortify our position as leaders in the industry. Embark on a journey with the worlds largest international airline and become a vital part of our cutting-

The IT Operations & Support Engineer will restore normal IT service operations within agreed service levels and business priorities and minimise the adverse impact on business operations for Emirates Group and External Clients. q: Strong analytical, troubleshooting and root cause analysis skills, with experience resolving complex application issues across application, integration, database and infrastructure layers and identifying permanent solutions.

Hands-on experience with ITSM platforms such as ServiceNow and ITIL practices including Incident, Problem, Change, Knowledge and Service Request Management, with strong focus on SLA compliance and service restoration.
Working knowledge of application stacks such as Java, Python and Node.js, REST APIs and integrations, along with cloud-native technologies including microservices, containers and Kubernetes.
Experience using tools such as Dynatrace, Splunk, Grafana or AppDynamics to investigate alerts, analyse logs and performance, identify service degradation and monitor application/service health.

Working knowledge sufficient to troubleshoot application-related database issues across Oracle, PostgreSQL, MongoDB or Couchbase; network/connectivity issues including LAN/WAN, latency, DNS and API failures; and identity/access issues involving Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID and Microsoft 365.

Experience identifying automation and shift-left opportunities and using AI/GenAI capabilities to improve incident triage, troubleshooting, documentation, knowledge management and routine resolution activities.

Strong customer service, communication and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to take ownership of technical issues, manage multiple priorities, coordinate cross-functional technical teams and vendors, and drive escalations through resolution within agreed SLAs.
